scripts.start:server: cd go-server && if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi && go build -o ccu-addon-mui-server-local . && exec ./ccu-addon-mui-server-local
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:server" "npm run start:fe"
scripts.export:ccu: cd go-server && if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi && go run ./cmd/ccu-export
scripts.start:server:fake: cd go-server && CCU_HOST=127.0.0.1 REGA_PORT=18181 RPC_PORT=12001 HMIP_PORT=12010 VIRTUAL_DEVICES_PORT=19292 WIRED_PORT=12000 CCU_WEBUI_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18080 CCU_WWW_DIR=../fixtures/www AUTH_KEY_FILE=../.fake-ccu-auth.key go run .
scripts.dev:fake: concurrently --kill-others --names ccu,server,frontend --prefix-colors yellow,blue,green "npm run start:fakeccu" "npm run start:server:fake" "npm run start:fe"
scripts.postbuild: npm run remove:build && npm run copy:build && npm run tar:gz
scripts.generate:protocol: json2ts -i protocol/schema.json -o src/types/protocol.ts --unreachableDefinitions --bannerComment "/* Generated from protocol/schema.json by npm run generate:protocol. Do not edit. */"
scripts.docs:screenshots: DOCS=1 playwright test docs-screenshots && DOCS=1 playwright test -c playwright.stack.config.ts docs-screenshots
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: npm run test:e2e:coverage:collect && npm run test:e2e:coverage:report
scripts.test:e2e:coverage:collect: rm -rf .nyc_output coverage/playwright && mkdir -p .nyc_output && PW_COVERAGE=1 playwright test
scripts.copy:build: npm run build:go-server && mkdir -p addon_installer/dist && cp -r dist/ccu-addon-mui/* addon_installer/dist && node scripts/compress-assets.mjs && npm run write:version
scripts.tar:gz: V=$(npm run version:current --silent) && T='tar --owner=0 --group=0 --mode=u=rwX,go=rX -cz' && $T -f mui-$V-arm-ccu3-raspi.tar.gz --exclude=./go-server/ccu-addon-mui-server-amd64 -C addon_installer . && $T -f mui-$V-x86_64-pc.tar.gz --exclude=./go-server/ccu-addon-mui-server-arm -C addon_installer .
